body:
This stuff is a miracle in a tube!

There will also be a couple of pictures I took tonight with no mascara on and my brows. I am on my 4th or 5th tube of lash serum and my 2nd tube of brow. My brows are still a work in progress though. 
I have never used false lashes or anything like it in my life. I was to the point of considering starting to wear them because of how dull and lifeless my lashes were. I got introduced to Babe lash serum through a free sample that was offered to me one day several months ago while scrolling through my Facebook. Let me tell ya, I am SO glad I chose to click that button! I used it consistently and at first I started to shed more lashes than I normally would and was starting to get really worried, but I had trust in the process and continued on. After shedding way more than usual, it grew back so much better and healthier! I can't stress this enough (through my experience with the lash and brow serums) - IT GETS WORSE BEFORE IT GETS BETTER! - Trust the process and be patient. I now have such long, fuller and more voluminous lashes and brow hair! After seeing the amazing results with my lashes, I figured I could use the lash serum on my brows too, and it worked! So I went and bought their brow products too. They all work equally well for me! 
Once they get to a good length, start using it every other day. The only odd thing I've experienced myself, is there is a slight discoloration on my top lash line. It has faded over time though. If your lash line starts to feel sensitive, that's when you know you're using too much product. It only takes very little! One dip for both eyes. I like to use the very tip for one eye and lay the brush flat-ish for the other side. It disperses the product evenly that way. I am so in love with my lashes now! I have even been asked so many different times if I'm wearing falsies. I tell them no but once they take a closer look, they realize they're real! I have recommended Babe Original products to family, friends and even all the gals at my work.
I highly recommend Babe products to anyone looking for longer and fuller looking lashes (and brows)!
